class.name: TiledMeshInstance3D
class.brief_description: Streams tiled mesh datasets into a 3D world.
class.description: Selects a registered format adapter, loads a dataset asynchronously, and streams its logical tiles and contents as cameras move. Generated resources remain in memory and are not saved into the scene. Local files, [code]res://[/code], [code]user://[/code], and HTTP(S) sources are supported. Formats can use distance, projected-pixel, or screen-space-error selection and ADD or REPLACE refinement.

method.name: close
method.description: Cancels pending work and releases all generated rendering resources.

method.name: get_dataset_aabb
method.description: Returns the stable local-space bounds of the root dataset.

method.name: get_resident_aabb
method.description: Returns the combined local-space bounds of resident geometry.

method.name: get_streaming_stats
method.description: Returns current request, mesh packing, packed-ready, residency, visibility, texture, and memory statistics. [code]waiting_contents[/code] counts desired contents waiting for a request slot or mesh packing capacity; [code]requested_contents[/code] counts requests already in progress.

method.name: intersect_ray
method.description: Intersects a world-space ray with resident triangles and returns the nearest hit, or an empty dictionary. The format-neutral result includes [code]position[/code], [code]normal[/code], [code]distance[/code], tile/content/primitive/triangle identifiers, [code]batch_id[/code], and [code]properties[/code] when supplied by the format. No physics bodies are created.

method.name: intersect_screen_point
method.description: Projects a ray through [param screen_point] using [param camera] and returns the same nearest-hit dictionary as [method intersect_ray].

method.name: local_to_world
method.description: Converts a Godot-local position to three double-precision source coordinates.

method.name: open
method.description: Starts asynchronous loading of [member source_uri]. Returns an [enum Error] code.

method.name: reload
method.description: Closes and opens the current source again. Returns an [enum Error] code.

method.name: set_streaming_paused
method.description: Pauses new streaming and uploads without unloading resident geometry.

method.name: set_world_origin
method.description: Sets the double-precision source origin used to place tile-local geometry.

method.name: world_to_local
method.description: Converts double-precision source coordinates to a Godot-local position.

signal.name: streaming_stats_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the root content or node lifecycle changes. Use [signal tile_loaded] and [signal tile_failed] for high-frequency child content completion, and call [method get_streaming_stats] when a fresh aggregate snapshot is needed.

constants.constant: Uses the origin selected by the active format adapter.
